description.zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的地域。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~27584~~)接口查询地域ID。

> 当您所选地域的Enpoint（服务地址）为slb.aliyuncs.com时，`RegionId`必填。
description.en:
The region where the CLB instance is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~27584~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

> If the endpoint of the selected region is slb.aliyuncs.com, you must specify `RegionId`.

description.zh:
资源的标签键。N的取值范围：**1~20**。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key must be 1 to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs`:. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
资源的标签值。N的取值范围：**1~20**。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value cannot be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

title.zh: 查询指定地域的服务器证书列表

descriptions.zh: > 为了保证安全性，只返回证书的指纹和名称，不返回证书和私钥的内容。
descriptions.en: > For security reasons, only the fingerprints and names of server certificates are returned. The content of server certificates and private keys is not returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb describe-server-certificates --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --server-certificate-id 123157900000000_166f8204689_1714763408_709981430 --resource-group-id rg-atstuj3rtop0000 --tag Value=1 Key=test --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
